A guilty verdict in Los Angeles, Steve Futterman reports.
The jury found Jonathan Rinderkinesh, a former Uber driver,
guilty of starting the Luckman fire on January 1st last year. That fire was never completely

The defense suggested that the Luckman fire started from fireworks. Juror number three,

barriers that went into effect when the U.K. left the E.U. in 2020. We'll have Mark's reports.
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham calls it a good day for Britain.
This latest deal does away with most border checks on British food sold into the European Union,
something U.K. exporters have complained about since Brexit was finalized six years ago.
In exchange, Britain will be forced to follow some E.U. rules on agricultural production.
Also, up to 100,000 young Brits will be able to live, work, and study in the E.U. for up to three

money and has given Britain six months to agree insisting the deal depends on it.
The Brexit campaigner and now leader of the U.K.'s Reform Party, Nigel Farage,

Brexit deal. For NPR News, I'm Willem Marks in London.

drawing criticism because a draft of the proposed final agreement failed to mention fossil fuels

to suck carbon dioxide out of the atmosphere. Scientists say it's almost certain that most

polluting nations, including the U.S., are not attending. I'm Dan Ronan, NPR News.
